top_signals.title: Buffeted on All Sides, Chile Bond Traders Focus on the Fed
top_signals.summary: Of all the factors buffeting Chile’s bond market at the moment, it’s the Federal Reserve and the outlook for further rate hikes in the world’s largest economy that are capturing the most attention.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia’s Crucial Oil Pipeline Starts Exports After Repairs
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia has started exporting oil using a key cross-country pipeline after the link was repaired following drone strikes earlier this month, a person with direct knowledge of the matter said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
